Agire come orchestratore strategico e voce delle regioni, garantendo un forte allineamento tra la direzione globale e le esigenze del mercato regionale. Principali responsabilità
• Guidare la pianificazione strategica internazionale per il portafoglio Rhinology, traducendo la strategia globale in chiare priorità esecutive.

• Servire come collegamento primario tra leadership internazionale e team di marketing regionale, assicurando intuizioni regionali informare la strategia.
• Lead marketing a valle internazionale, tra cui posizionamento, proposizioni di valore e strategia competitiva.
• Abilitare l'esecuzione costante e di alta qualità del mercato in tutte le regioni, consentendo al contempo le esigenze del mercato locale.
• Collaborare con i team di educazione medica e clinica per sostenere lo sviluppo del mercato e la diffusione delle prove cliniche.
• Esecuzione del programma interfunzionale (Marketing, Medical, Sales, R&D), assicurando la consegna e l'allineamento disciplinati.
• Guidare il mercato internazionale e le informazioni dei clienti per informare la strategia e l'esecuzione. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You’ll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world. A Day in the Life Role Purpose Drive international commercial success for the ENT Rhinology and Otology portfolio by translating strategy into clear priorities and scalable execution across regions. Act as the strategic orchestrator and voice of the regions, ensuring strong alignment between global direction and regional market needs. Key Responsibilities
• Lead international strategic planning for the Rhinology portfolio, translating global strategy into clear executional priorities.
• Own the international Rhinology strategic framework, including therapy growth initiatives, launch readiness, and adoption programs.
• Serve as the primary liaison between international leadership and regional marketing teams, ensuring regional insights inform strategy.
• Lead international downstream marketing, including positioning, value propositions, and competitive strategy.
• Enable consistent, high‑quality go‑to‑market execution across regions while allowing for local market needs.
• Partner with Medical Education and Clinical teams to support market development and clinical evidence dissemination.
• Lead cross‑functional program execution (Marketing, Medical, Sales, R&D), ensuring disciplined delivery and alignment.
• Drive international market and customer insights to inform strategy and execution. Qualifications
• Experience in international marketing, portfolio, or strategic program leadership along with demonstrated ability to translate strategy into execution at scale
• Strong cross‑functional leadership and stakeholder influence with experience working across regions and cultures
• Medical device or therapy‑based portfolio experience
• MBA or advanced degree #LI-Flex Physical Job Requirements The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. Benefits & Compensation Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.
